name: mazoom
description: Plan events, build guest lists, send WhatsApp invitations and follow RSVPs with your Mazoom account.

interface.longDescription:
Mazoom sends digital invitations for weddings, engagements, graduations and company events, and tracks who is coming. Connect your Mazoom account to plan and manage your events from the conversation.

- Create and update events: date, time, venue, invitation text and design.
- Build the guest list from your Mazoom contacts or a pasted list, and set how many companions each guest may bring.
- Send WhatsApp invitations, reminders, entry QR codes and thank-you messages.
- See who has confirmed, declined or not replied yet, and read guests' WhatsApp replies.
- Set up registration questions for open events.
- Get delivery and attendance summaries for each event.

Before the assistant sends any message or adds guests, it shows what will happen and who will be messaged, and asks you to confirm.

The connector can't delete anything, check guests in, or answer an invitation on a guest's behalf. You do those in the Mazoom app.

You need a Mazoom account. Sign in with your email and password, or with a code sent to your WhatsApp.
capabilities: Build guest lists from contacts or pasted lists
Send WhatsApp invitations, reminders and thank-you messages after you confirm
Track RSVPs and read guests' replies
defaultPrompt: Which of my upcoming events still have guests who haven't replied?
Add Sara Ahmed from my contacts to the Demo Wedding
من أكد حضوره لحفل الزفاف حتى الآن؟

positive.description: Lists the signed-in host's upcoming events.
positive.prompt: What events do I have coming up?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the upcoming events, including the Demo Wedding, with each event's date and venue. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: How many guests have confirmed, declined or not replied for the Demo Wedding?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the Demo Wedding's confirmed, declined and no-reply counts. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Adds a guest from the address book after the user confirms.
positive.prompt: Add Sara Ahmed from my contacts to the Demo Wedding with one companion.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Sara Ahmed in the contacts and the Demo Wedding, says that adding her uses one of the account's credits, and asks the user to confirm. After the user confirms, adds her with one companion. If she is already on the guest list, says so and changes nothing.

positive.description: Sends a WhatsApp reminder to guests who haven't replied, after showing who will be messaged and getting the user's confirmation.
positive.prompt: Send a reminder with the location to the Demo Wedding guests who haven't replied.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the guests who haven't replied, shows who will get the WhatsApp reminder, and asks the user to confirm. After the user confirms, sends the reminder and reports how many guests it went to. The guests in this account are the developer's own test phones.

positive.description: Answers in Arabic with the guests who confirmed.
positive.prompt: من أكد حضوره لحفل الزفاف حتى الآن؟
positive.expected_behavior: Replies in Arabic with the names of the Demo Wedding guests who confirmed and how many companions each is bringing. Nothing is changed.

negative.description: Credits can't be bought through the plugin. It should explain that credits are bought in the Mazoom app or at mazoom.sa, and offer no checkout.
The plugin can't delete anything. It should explain that events are deleted in the Mazoom app and change nothing.
Another account's or a nonexistent event. It should say the event wasn't found and reveal nothing about other accounts.
negative.prompt: Show me the guest list for event 999999.

publication.release_notes: First release of Mazoom for ChatGPT: create and update events, build guest lists, send WhatsApp invitations, reminders and thank-you messages after you confirm, and follow RSVPs, replies and delivery.
